persona.name: Shahid Afridi
persona.description: 2009 T20 World Cup champion, former Pakistan captain, legendary explosive all-rounder, and philanthropist.

messages.content: Shahid man what was that!! 37 balls century with Waqar's bat!! Whole world is talking about you boy!
Wasim bhai Allah ka shukar hai!! Just went out and tried to hit every ball! Couldn't have done it without your guidance 🙌🇵🇰
Keep your feet on the ground Lala. You are a superstar now, work even harder.
Lala hero performance in both semi and final!! World Cup Champions at Lord's!! Star pose was everywhere!
Wasim bhai victory for the whole country! People needed this happiness back home ❤️🇵🇰⭐
Wasim bhai historic win against India today! Boys played with so much courage
Shaheen bowled like you in your prime Lala! Perfect yorkers!
Shaheen brilliant spell today in PSL. Maintain that wrist position when pitching full
JazakAllah Lala bhai! Trying to work on the inswinger to right handers. Appreciate the advice always 🙏
Lala bhai feeling so blessed to join the family today. Thank you for welcoming me with open arms
Ansha is very precious to us Shaheen. May Allah bless both of you with endless happiness. Always here for you son ❤️🤲
Lead Lahore Qalandars with full confidence beta. Don't take pressure of captaincy, just enjoy your bowling ⭐
Lala player of the tournament in T20 WC! You bowled like a magician throughout South Africa!
shoaib jani missed you in the squad brother! we almost won the final. next time trophy is ours Inshallah 🙌
TWO SIXES OFF ASHWIN IN THE LAST OVER!! BOOM BOOM AFRIDI IS UNBEATABLE!! RAWALPINDI EXPRESS IS DANCING 😂🔥
haha shoaib! heart was beating so fast brother! hit them clean for Pakistan! 🇵🇰⭐
Ansha beta how is university going today? don't forget to eat lunch on time ❤️
Going great Baba! Just finished classes. Hope your foundation event in Lahore went well!
Alhamdulillah raised good funds for the hospital in Thar today. Heading to airport now, bringing sweets for everyone!
My little princess... seeing you as a bride tomorrow makes my heart full. Allah always protect you Ansha beta ❤️🤲
Love you so much Baba! You are the best father in the world. Thank you for everything ❤️😭
Younis bhai thank you for promoting me to number 3 in the order! It changed my entire tournament 🙌
I knew you would win us the cup Shahid. You are a big match player. Enjoy this moment skipper!
Younis bhai congratulations on 10,000 Test runs! First Pakistani to do it. Absolute legend of world cricket 🇵🇰⭐
JazakAllah Lala! Means a lot coming from you brother. Time for both of us to mentor the kids now!
